c74object.name: el.samm~
c74object.description:
el.samm~ ("Sample Accurate Multiple Metronomes") is a multi-stream pulse generator that produces sample-accurate rhythmic triggers. Each allocated stream outputs a single-sample impulse (1.0) on its downbeat and 0.0 at all other times. Multiple streams can run at independent metric subdivisions (divbeats), beat lengths (beats), millisecond intervals (msbeats), sample counts (sampbeats), or metric ratios (ratiobeats). All streams remain locked in phase sync even during continuous tempo changes. An incoming audio click at the inlet instantly resets and resynchronizes all streams.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal / messages): Sync/reset impulse input and control message inlet (tempo, beats, divbeats, msbeats, sampbeats, ratiobeats, arm, pause, resume, tap_tempo, tap_end, mute). A non-zero audio sample immediately resets all metronome streams to the downbeat and resumes playback.
Outlets
Outlets 1 to N (signal): Beat stream impulse outputs (one outlet per subdivision specified at instantiation). Emits a single-sample 1.0 impulse on downbeats, and 0.0 at all other times.

inlet.description: Non-zero audio samples reset all streams to the downbeat and unpause playback. Also accepts all tempo, timing, and transport control messages.

outlet.description: Outputs a single-sample 1.0 impulse on downbeats for stream 1, and 0.0 otherwise.
Subsequent beat stream outputs (one outlet for each stream defined at instantiation).

objarg.name: tempo
objarg.description: Required. Basic tempo in beats per minute.

objarg.name: beat-subdivisions
objarg.description: Required. One or more beat divisors defining the number of metronome outlets (e.g. 4 divides the beat into 4 parts, 1 is once per beat, 0.25 is once every 4 beats). Each value creates a separate audio outlet.

method.name: arm
method.description: Resets all metronome streams to the downbeat and pauses playback. Playback can be started with resume or by sending an audio click into the inlet.

method.name: beatinfo
method.description: Prints current tempo, samples per beat, and individual stream durations to the Max Console.

method.name: beats
method.description: Specifies stream timings as durations in beats (e.g. 4 triggers once every 4 beats). The number of values must equal the number of metronome outlets.

method.name: divbeats
method.description: Specifies stream timings as beat divisors (e.g. 4 triggers 4 times per beat). The number of values must equal the number of metronome outlets.

method.name: msbeats
method.description: Specifies stream intervals as absolute durations in milliseconds (e.g. 250 triggers four times per second). The number of values must equal the number of metronome outlets.

method.name: mute
method.description: When set to 1, mutes DSP computation and outputs silence across all outlets. When set to 0 (default), normal trigger emission resumes.

method.name: pause
method.description: Pauses all metronomes, retaining their current countdown phases.

method.name: ratiobeats
method.description: Specifies stream timings as numerator/denominator ratio pairs relative to a whole note at the current tempo (e.g. 1 4 yields a quarter note; 1 12 yields an eighth-note triplet). Requires two values per metronome outlet.

method.name: resume
method.description: Restarts paused metronomes from their current phase positions.

method.name: sampbeats
method.description: Specifies stream intervals as absolute durations in samples. The number of values must equal the number of metronome outlets.

method.name: tap_end
method.description: Concludes the tap tempo measurement started by tap_tempo, calculates the resulting BPM, updates all stream countdowns, and resumes playback.

method.name: tap_tempo
method.description: Arms the object and begins counting sample elapsed time to measure a new tempo. The interval between this message and tap_end defines one beat (quarter note).

method.name: tempo
method.description: Sets the base tempo in beats per minute. All streams scale their countdown intervals immediately while preserving phase synchronization.

method.name: signal
method.description: Any non-zero audio sample received at inlet 1 resets all metronomes to the downbeat and unpauses playback immediately.
